description: This file contains React custom hooks `useCourses` and `useCourseMutations` that manage fetching, creating, updating, and deleting course data from a backend database (Supabase). It also handles role-based access for admin, instructor, and student roles, and implements optimistic UI updates for mutations.

methods.name: useCourses()
methods.description: React hook to fetch list of courses based on user role (admin, instructor, student). It manages loading, error states, and provides a refresh method.

methods.name: useCourseMutations({ onLocalUpdate } = {})
methods.description: React hook to create, update, and delete courses with optimistic UI updates and role-based authorization.
